mapper.select: select a.*, p.id p_id, p.name p_name,dg.name device_group_name, es.name event_source_name from iot_linkage a left join iot_event_source es on a.event_source_id = es.id left join ( select ca.name, ca.id, if(ca.type='device', cp.product_ids, ca.product_ids) product_ids from iot_device_group ca left join iot_device_group cp on ca.pid=cp.id ) as dg on es.device_group_id = dg.id left join iot_product p on json_contains(dg.product_ids, concat('', p.id)) where a.id=#{id}

select a.*, p.id p_id, p.name p_name,dg.name device_group_name, es.name event_source_name from iot_linkage a left join iot_event_source es on a.event_source_id = es.id left join ( select ca.name, ca.id, if(ca.type='device', cp.product_ids, ca.product_ids) product_ids from iot_device_group ca left join iot_device_group cp on ca.pid=cp.id ) as dg on es.device_group_id = dg.id left join iot_product p on json_contains(dg.product_ids, concat('', p.id)) where a.id=#{id}
